sentences.en: jane : Hello, Jane Fairbanks speaking.
sentences.zh: jane : 你好，我是简·费尔班克斯。

sentences.en: frank : Oh, good morning.
sentences.zh: frank : 哦，早上好。

sentences.en: My name's Frank Pritchard.
sentences.zh: 我的名字是弗兰克·普里查德。

sentences.en: I've just retired and moved to Southoe.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚退休，搬到了索斯欧。

sentences.en: I'd like to become a volunteer, and I gather you co-ordinate voluntary work in the village.
sentences.zh: 我想成为一名志愿者，听说您负责协调村里的志愿工作。

sentences.en: jane : That's right.
sentences.zh: jane : 没错。

sentences.en: frank : What sort of thing could I do?
sentences.zh: frank : 我能做些什么工作呢？

sentences.en: jane : Well, we need help with the village library.
sentences.zh: jane : 嗯，我们需要人手协助村图书馆的工作。

sentences.en: We borrow books from the town library, and individuals also donate them.
sentences.zh: 我们从镇上的图书馆借书，个人也会向我们捐赠图书。

sentences.en: So, one thing you could do is get involved in collecting them – if you've got a car, that is.
sentences.zh: 因此，您可以参与图书收集工作——前提是您有车。

sentences.en: frank : Yes, that's no problem.
sentences.zh: frank : 是的，这完全没问题。

sentences.en: jane : The times are pretty flexible so we can arrange it to suit you.
sentences.zh: jane : 时间安排非常灵活，我们可以根据您的情况来协调。

sentences.en: Another thing is the records that we keep of the books we're given, and those we borrow and need to return to the town library.
sentences.zh: 另一项工作是整理我们所收到图书的记录，以及我们借阅后需归还给镇图书馆的图书记录。

sentences.en: It would be very useful to have another person to help keep them up to date.
sentences.zh: 再增加一名人员来协助更新这些记录将非常有用。

sentences.en: frank : Right.
sentences.zh: frank : 明白了。

sentences.en: I'm used to working on a computer – I presume they're computerised?
sentences.zh: 我习惯使用电脑——我猜这些记录都是电脑化的吧？

sentences.en: jane : Oh yes.
sentences.zh: jane : 哦，是的。

sentences.en: frank : Is the library purpose-built?
sentences.zh: frank : 这个图书馆是专门建造的吗？

sentences.en: I haven't noticed it when I've walked round the village.
sentences.zh: 我在村里散步时好像没注意到它。

sentences.en: jane : No, we simply have the use of a room in the village hall, the West Room.
sentences.zh: jane : 不是的，我们只是使用村礼堂里的一间房间，即西厅。

sentences.en: It's on the left as you go in.
sentences.zh: 您进门后左边就是。

sentences.en: frank : I must go and have a look inside the hall.
sentences.zh: frank : 我得去礼堂里面看看。

sentences.en: jane : Yes, it's a nice building.
sentences.zh: jane : 是的，那是一座很漂亮的建筑。

sentences.en: frank : Do you run a lunch club in the village for elderly people?
sentences.zh: frank : 村里是否为老年人开设午餐俱乐部？

sentences.en: I know a lot of places do.
sentences.zh: 我知道很多地方都有这样的俱乐部。

sentences.en: jane : Yes, we have a very successful club.
sentences.zh: jane : 是的，我们的俱乐部办得非常成功。

sentences.en: frank : I could help with transport, if that's of any use.
sentences.zh: frank : 如果需要的话，我可以帮忙提供交通服务。

sentences.en: jane : Ooo definitely.
sentences.zh: jane : 哦，当然需要！

sentences.en: People come to the club from neighbouring villages, and we're always in need of more drivers.
sentences.zh: 参加俱乐部的人来自周边村庄，我们一直急需更多司机。

sentences.en: frank : And does the club have groups that focus on a particular hobby, too?
sentences.zh: frank : 那么，俱乐部是否也设有专注于特定爱好的小组呢？

sentences.en: I could get involved in one or two, particularly if there are any art groups.
sentences.zh: 我可以参加一两个，尤其是如果有美术类小组的话。

sentences.en: jane : Excellent.
sentences.zh: jane : 太好了。

sentences.en: I'll find out where we need help and get back to you.
sentences.zh: 我会查清楚哪些地方需要帮助，然后尽快联系您。

sentences.en: frank : Fine.
sentences.zh: frank : 好的。

sentences.en: What about help for individual residents.
sentences.zh: 那么，针对个别居民的帮助呢？

sentences.en: Do you arrange that at all?
sentences.zh: 您会安排这类服务吗？

sentences.en: jane : Yes, we do it as a one-off.
sentences.zh: jane : 是的，我们提供一次性帮助。

sentences.en: In fact, there's Mrs Carroll.
sentences.zh: 事实上，卡罗尔夫人目前就有需求。

sentences.en: She needs a lift to the hospital next week, and we're struggling to find someone.
sentences.zh: 她下周需要去医院，而我们正难以找到合适的人选送她。

sentences.en: frank : When's her appointment?
sentences.zh: frank : 她的预约时间是什么时候？

sentences.en: jane : On Tuesday.
sentences.zh: jane：星期二。

sentences.en: It would take the whole morning.
sentences.zh: 这会占用整个上午。

sentences.en: frank : I could do that.
sentences.zh: frank：我可以做这件事。

sentences.en: jane : Oh, that would be great.
sentences.zh: jane：哦，那太好了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And also, next week, we're arranging to have some work done to Mr Selsbury's house before he moves, as he isn't healthy enough to do it himself.
sentences.zh: 另外，下周我们打算在塞尔兹伯里先生搬入之前，为他的房子做一些修缮工作，因为他身体不够健康，无法自己完成。

sentences.en: We've got some people to decorate his kitchen, but if you could do some weeding in his garden, that would be wonderful.
sentences.zh: 我们已安排了一些人来粉刷他的厨房，但如果你能在他的花园里除草，那就太棒了。

sentences.en: frank : OK.
sentences.zh: frank：好的。

sentences.en: I'd enjoy that.
sentences.zh: 我很乐意做这件事。

sentences.en: And presumably the day and time are flexible.
sentences.zh: 而且，日期和时间应该是可以灵活安排的吧？

sentences.en: jane : Oh yes.
sentences.zh: jane：哦，是的。

sentences.en: Just say when would suit you best, and we'll let Mr Selsbury know.
sentences.zh: 你只需告诉我们你什么时候最方便，我们会通知塞尔兹伯里先生。

sentences.en: frank : Good.
sentences.zh: frank：好的。

sentences.en: jane : The volunteers group also organises monthly social events, which is a great way to meet other people, of course.
sentences.zh: jane：志愿者小组还每月组织一次社交活动，当然，这也是结识其他人的绝佳方式。

sentences.en: 更多雅思干货，添加教主微信：519690129 Audioscripts frank : Uhuh.
sentences.zh: 更多雅思干货，添加教主微信：519690129 音频脚本 frank：嗯哼。

sentences.en: jane : So next month, on the 19th of October, we're holding a quiz – a couple of residents are great at planning unusual ones, and we always fill the village hall.
sentences.zh: jane：因此，下个月，也就是10月19日，我们将举办一场知识问答比赛——有几位居民特别擅长策划别出心裁的问答活动，我们每次都能把村礼堂坐满。

sentences.en: frank : That sounds like fun.
sentences.zh: frank：听起来很有趣。

sentences.en: Can I do anything to help?
sentences.zh: 我能帮上什么忙吗？

sentences.en: jane : Well, because of the number of people, we need plenty of refreshments for halfway through.
sentences.zh: jane：由于参加人数较多，我们需要准备大量茶点，供活动进行到一半时享用。

sentences.en: So, if you could provide any, we'd be grateful.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你能提供一些，我们将不胜感激。

sentences.en: frank : I'm sure I could.
sentences.zh: frank：我肯定可以。

sentences.en: I'll think about what to make, and let you know.
sentences.zh: 我会考虑一下做什么，然后告诉你。

sentences.en: jane : Thank you.
sentences.zh: jane：谢谢。

sentences.en: Then on November the 18th, we're holding a dance, also in the village hall.
sentences.zh: 接着，11月18日，我们将在村礼堂举办一场舞会。

sentences.en: We've booked a band that specialises in music of the 1930s – they've been before, and we've had a lot of requests to bring them back.
sentences.zh: 我们已预订了一支专长于20世纪30年代音乐的乐队——他们之前来过，而且我们收到了很多要求再次邀请他们的呼声。

sentences.en: frank : I'm not really a dancer, but I'd like to do something to help.
sentences.zh: frank：我其实不太会跳舞，但我很想帮忙做些事情。

sentences.en: jane : Well, we sell tickets in advance, and having an extra person to check them at the door, as people arrive, would be good – it can be quite a bottleneck if everyone arrives at once!
sentences.zh: jane：嗯，我们提前售票，如果能在人们入场时多安排一个人在门口检票，那就很好了——因为如果大家同时到达，门口很容易出现拥堵！

sentences.en: frank : OK, I'm happy with that.
sentences.zh: frank：好的，我很乐意承担这项工作。

sentences.en: jane : We're also arranging a New Year's Eve party.
sentences.zh: jane：我们还在筹备一场新年除夕派对。

sentences.en: We're expecting that to be a really big event, so instead of the village hall, it'll be held in the Mountfort Hotel.
sentences.zh: 预计这将是一场规模盛大的活动，因此地点不再设在村礼堂，而是改在蒙特福特酒店。

sentences.en: frank : The …?
sentences.zh: frank：……？

sentences.en: jane : Mountfort.
sentences.zh: jane：蒙特福特。

sentences.en: M-O-U-N-T-F-O-R-T Hotel.
sentences.zh: M-O-U-N-T-F-O-R-T 酒店。

sentences.en: It isn't in Southoe itself, but it's only a couple of miles away.
sentences.zh: 它并不在索斯欧镇内，但距离那里只有几英里远。

sentences.en: The hotel will be providing dinner and we've booked a band.
sentences.zh: 酒店将提供晚餐，我们也已预订了一支乐队。

sentences.en: The one thing we haven't got yet is a poster.
sentences.zh: 目前唯一还没落实的是海报。

sentences.en: That isn't something you could do, by any chance, is it?
sentences.zh: 不知你是否碰巧能帮忙设计一张？

sentences.en: frank : Well actually, yes.
sentences.zh: frank：实际上，可以的。

sentences.en: Before I retired I was a graphic designer, so that's right up my street.
sentences.zh: 我退休前是一名平面设计师，所以这正合我意。

sentences.en: jane : Oh perfect!
sentences.zh: jane：哦，太完美了！

sentences.en: I'll give you the details, and then perhaps you could send me a draft …
sentences.zh: 我来给您详细说明一下，然后您或许可以发一份草稿给我……

sentences.en: frank : Of course.
sentences.zh: frank：当然可以。
